title: Feed generation crashes with HTTP 403 on GitHub search API page 3 (secondary rate limit)
description:
The scheduled "Update Feed" workflow fails on most runs, so the published Atom feeds (formulas.xml / casks.xml) are rarely updated.

ROOT CAUSE
- Traceback terminates at generate_feed.py:80 inside fetch_new_commits(), calling GitHub's /search/commits API.
- CI logs show "Page 1: 100 results", "Page 2: 100 results", then HTTP Error 403: Forbidden on page 3.
- This is GitHub's *secondary* (abuse) rate limit on the Search API, which throttles bursts far more aggressively than the documented 30 req/min authenticated limit. The 2s inter-page sleep added in a84b24a is insufficient.
- Intermittent: ~most runs fail on page 3; occasionally all 3 pages slip through (rare success seen 2026-06-02 05:50 UTC).
- Impact: any 403 on any page raises and aborts the whole job (both formula and cask feeds), so nothing deploys. (Silver lining: the crash means GitHub Pages keeps the last good deploy rather than publishing an empty feed.)

PROPOSED FIX
- Add retry-with-backoff on 403/429 for the search requests, honoring Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset headers, else exponential backoff (capped).
- Degrade gracefully: if a later page still fails after retries, proceed with the pages already fetched instead of crashing. Only re-raise if page 1 itself fails (so we never deploy an empty feed over a good one).
- Add a descriptive User-Agent header (GitHub-recommended; can reduce throttling).
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled runs succeed reliably; transient search-API 403s no longer abort the job; formulas.xml and casks.xml are regenerated with entries; if the API is genuinely unavailable for page 1, the job fails loudly and the last good feed is preserved.
notes: Implemented in generate_feed.py: _request_json() retry/backoff on 403/429 (honors Retry-After & X-RateLimit-Reset, else 5/10/20/40s capped 60), descriptive User-Agent, and graceful degradation in fetch_new_commits() (proceed with pages already fetched; only re-raise if page 1 fails). Locally reproduced the exact bug — cask page 2 returned 403 and recovered on the 4th retry — and confirmed both feeds build (150 formulas, 122 casks, all XML well-formed). Pending: push + confirm green in CI, then close.

title: Add project homepage link to feed entry body
description: Fetch the homepage field from the bulk Homebrew Formulae API and include it as a link in each feed entry's HTML content body, alongside the existing formulae.brew.sh and commit links.
